title: Irish Pork Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish-style pork stew made with tender pork, root vegetables, and a hint of savory flavor.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew seasoning, salt, and pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the pork to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Add the potatoes to the pot and continue to simmer for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
